name: multivalue-basic-analyser
description: Generate documentation reports for Rocket UniVerse BASIC programs, including the internal call tree with Mermaid or Markmap diagrams, file usage, metrics and warnings.

mvbasicAnalyser.outputFolder.markdownDescription: Folder where reports are saved. When empty, reports are saved in `docs/uvdoc` within the workspace, or in a `uvdoc` folder next to the program if no workspace is open. Relative paths are resolved from the workspace folder. Supports `${workspaceFolder}`, `${fileDirname}` and `~`.

enumDescriptions: Open the report in a web browser. Requires a Markdown viewer extension in the browser.
Open the report in VS Code's built-in Markdown preview.
Open the report in both the browser and the Markdown preview.
Save the report without opening it.
mvbasicAnalyser.openIn.description: Where the report opens after it is generated.

enumDescriptions: The application your operating system associates with .md files. This may be a text editor rather than a browser.
The browser specified in the 'Browser Path' setting.

mvbasicAnalyser.browserPath.description: Full path to the browser executable. Used only when 'Browser' is set to custom.

mvbasicAnalyser.diagram.description: Diagram format for the internal call tree. A plain-text call tree is always included.
enumDescriptions: Mermaid flowchart (supported by most Markdown viewers).
Markmap mind map (supported by fewer viewers).

mvbasicAnalyser.excludeRoutines.markdownDescription: Routine labels to omit from the call tree, its diagrams and the Internal routines table, for example `OPENFILES` or `ERR.HANDLE`. Matching is not case-sensitive; use `*` to match any characters and `?` to match a single character (for example `ERR.*`). Routines called only through an excluded routine are also omitted. Warnings are still reported for excluded routines.

mvbasicAnalyser.maxTreeDepth.description: Maximum depth of the internal call tree. Deeper calls are indicated with '…'.
